strings.name: James Heckman
strings.summary: Heckman studies sample selection, labour supply and policy evaluation, developing methods for bias in non-random samples. A longtime University of Chicago economist, he shared the 2000 economics prize with Daniel McFadden. His subsequent work on childhood interventions, skill formation and opportunity combines statistical methods with longitudinal research, informing analysis of education, training and anti-discrimination policy.

strings.influence.rationale: Developed microeconometric methods and researches early education, skill formation and inequalities in social opportunity.
